**PromptVault** is a native macOS menu bar app for storing, organizing, and instantly reusing AI prompts.
Press <kbd>⌃</kbd> <kbd>⌥</kbd> <kbd>P</kbd> anywhere, type a few letters, press <kbd>↩</kbd>, and the prompt is on your clipboard.

### Highlights

- **Menu bar popover** with instant, keyboard-driven search (default shortcut ⌃⌥P, configurable).
- **Fill-in variables**: `{{name}}` becomes a form with defaults and hints; `{{clipboard}}`, `{{date}}`, `{{time}}` and friends fill themselves in.
- **Library window** with nested folders, tags, smart collections, sorting, and bulk editing.
- **Version history** with a word-level diff and one-click, reversible restore.
- **Your data stays on your Mac**: no account, fully offline, JSON import and export, automatic daily backups.

### Install

1. Download **PromptVault-@VERSION@.dmg** below, open it, and drag **PromptVault** into **Applications**.
2. This build isn't notarized by Apple yet, so macOS blocks it the first time you open it. Try opening it once,
   then go to **System Settings → Privacy & Security** and choose **Open Anyway** for PromptVault. You only need to do this once.

Requires macOS 14 or later. Universal build for Apple Silicon and Intel Macs.

### Checksum

```
SHA-256 (PromptVault-@VERSION@.dmg) = @SHA256@
```
